app.title: Playlist Converter
app.subtitle: Merge multiple audio tracks into one file – up to 5 GB

bitrate.title: Audio Quality
bitrate.hint: Higher bitrate = better quality, larger file

mix.title: Transitions and editing
mix.loudnormHint: Quiet and loud tracks end up equally loud (−16 LUFS).
mix.reencodeHint: Transitions, loudness matching and trimming need re-encoding, so the conversion takes a little longer.
mix.trimSilence: Remove silence at start and end
mix.trimSilenceHint: Cuts silent parts at the edges of every track, e.g. before the intro.

trim.hint: Time as m:ss, e.g. 0:15 or 3:02.5. Empty = start or end of the track.
trim.invalid: Invalid range: the end must be after the start and within the track.

output.title: File name and tags
output.coverHint: JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB, embedded in MP3 files.
output.coverMp3Only: The cover is only embedded in MP3; it is left out for WebM/OGG.

image.lowContrast: Text and background barely stand apart. This is hard to read on a phone.

error.playlistTooLarge: The server rejected the upload: the playlist is larger than {max}. Please remove some files.
error.fileTooLarge: The server rejected the upload: a file is larger than {max}.
error.serverStorage: The server is low on free storage right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.
error.conversionFailed: The conversion failed. Please try again.
error.fileUnreadable: “{name}” could not be read. Please remove or replace the file.
error.statusFailed: The conversion status could not be retrieved.
error.network: No connection to the server. Please check your internet connection.
error.sessionExpired: The session has expired. Please start the conversion again.
error.alreadyConverting: This playlist is already being converted.
error.internal: Internal server error. Please try again later.
error.invalidCover: The cover must be a JPEG or PNG image up to 5 MB.
error.uploadInterrupted: The upload was interrupted. Files already sent stay on the server for one hour, so you can resume the upload.
error.resumeExpired: The interrupted upload is no longer on the server. Please start the conversion again.
